description: Run R CMD check on the package using devtools::check(). Identifies errors, warnings, and notes that would prevent CRAN submission.

cran.description: Whether to use CRAN-specific settings (default false).

document.description: Whether to run devtools::document() before checking (default true).

error_on.description: Minimum check severity that causes an error: 'never', 'note', 'warning', or 'error' (default 'warning').

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

name: check
